en.headline: Man, 29, arrested after alleged street assault in Shau Kei Wan
en.dek: Police say a woman reported being grabbed around the neck and indecently assaulted in Nam On Lane just after 1am; she did not need hospital treatment.
body: Police arrested a 29-year-old man on suspicion of indecent assault after a woman reported being attacked in Nam On Lane, Shau Kei Wan, early on Tuesday.

Officers said a 34-year-old woman called police at 1.05am, saying a man had put his arm around her neck and then allegedly touched her chest. The pair did not know each other, police said after a preliminary inquiry. The woman did not require hospital treatment.
The case is being handled by Eastern District's criminal investigation team. Police said the man was arrested at the scene.
Clips later circulated on social media showing a passer-by intervening after the woman called for help. Police have not released further details of the investigation.

zh.headline: 箏箕灣南安里女子報稱遭箍頸非禮 警拘29歲男子
zh.dek: 警方指凌晨1時05分接獲34歲女子報案，指在南安里被男子箍頸後懷疑被觸碰胸部，事主毋須送院。
body: 警方周二凌晨在箏箕灣南安里以涉嫌非禮拑捕一名29歲男子。
警方表示，凌晨1時05分接獲一名34歲女子報案，指被一名男子以手箍頸，其後對方懷疑觸碰其胸部。初步調查顯示兩人互不相識。女事主毋須送院。
案件交由東區警區刑事調查隊跟進。警方指男子在現場被捕。
其後有途人拍攝的片段在社交平台流傳，顯示有人上前喝止並協助報案。警方未有公布更多調查詳情。
